Information Security (M.Tech. - 2yrs)

Programme Outcomes (POs)
1 An ability to independently carry out research /investigation and development work to solve practical problems
2 An ability to write and present a substantial technical report/document
3 Students should be able to demonstrate a degree of mastery over the area as per the specialization of the program (Information Security). The mastery should be at a level higher than the requirements in the appropriate bachelor program
4 Students should have adequate technologies and theoretical background of software development that will help them to pursue a career in software industries
5 Students should be educated to stick on professional ethics and able to solve societal needs and developments
Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)
1 To produce competent graduates to analyze the security challenges and suggest suitable design solutions
2 To imbibe research aptitude among the graduates in the field of information security
3 To inculcate sound security fundamentals among the graduates to meet the over changing security needs
4 To instill ethical and social responsibility, team spirit, and leadership qualities among the students for nation building
